label: Two necessary concreta support each other, each at some admitted world
paraphrase: Rival framework commitment, unattributed (motivated by metaphysical interdependence among necessary beings): for some concrete candidates a and b, each existing at every world accessible from w, and worlds v and u, a exists at v and stands to b in the selected relation at v, and b exists at u and stands to a in the selected relation at u. The candidates may coincide and the worlds may coincide. No endless regress is asserted.
